hooks.command: python -c "import sys,json; p=json.load(sys.stdin)['tool_input']['file_path']; sys.exit(2 if any(p.endswith(x) for x in ['.env','.git/HEAD','.git/config']) or '.git/' in p.replace('\\','/') else 0)"
python -c "import sys,json; cmd=json.load(sys.stdin)['tool_input']['command']; sys.exit(2 if 'master' in cmd or 'main' in cmd else 0)"
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/quant_server" && python -m ruff format "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" --quiet 2>/dev/null; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then python -c "import sys,re; content=open(sys.argv[1]).read(); issues=[m.group() for m in re.finditer(r'(token|password|api_key|secret|TUSHARE_TOKEN)\s*=\s*[\"\\'](?!\$)[^\"\\']{8,}', content, re.I)]; sys.exit(2 if issues else 0)" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi
